purpose: Paper-only NFL market research controls. This is a project design, not a licence, wager, recommendation, or finding of profitability.

origination_order.label: Side · point spread
origination_order.research_state: First priority. Historical directional signal is provisional; no executable quote, ROI, CLV, or live release.
advance_only_if: official inputs and result reconciliation pass
the frozen side signal survives pre-registered prospective validation
an authorized opening/closing price source is registered
all release and risk controls pass

origination_order.label: Total
origination_order.research_state: Second priority. The current result board is 60–60; no fair over/under probability or price is established.
advance_only_if: the side-stage evidence and rights gates are reviewed first
a total model is registered before its prospective test
pace, drive, and game-context inputs have dated provenance
an authorized opening/closing price source is registered

origination_order.label: Moneyline
origination_order.research_state: Third priority. A model fair win probability / American price exists for the frozen Week 10 snapshot only; it is not a market quote and is not calibrated as a future edge.
advance_only_if: side and total stages have completed their review gates
moneyline probabilities pass independent prospective calibration
both sides of an authorized price are captured with timestamps and settlement rules
the same paper, rights, risk, and demotion controls pass

price_snapshot_contract.write_mode: append only; a repeated event/market/selection/phase/operator slot is rejected
price_snapshot_contract.one_record_per: game × market × mainline variant × selection × operator × phase

spread.line_convention: selected side's handicap; home and away are opposite-signed

total.line_convention: same total threshold for over and under

moneyline.line_convention: American odds only; no point line

price_snapshot_contract.source_registry_authorization: The registered source must itself state rights_status=authorized, a non-empty rights_scope and a non-sensitive rights_reference; the quote must carry that exact rights_reference. The quote URL must remain within the registered HTTPS host/path.
publish_only_when: HTTPS publisher is in the source registry
registered authorized-use scope and reference match the quote
evidence SHA-256 is present and format-valid; this project does not retain source evidence or compare the digest to it
price_snapshot_contract.empty_is_not_zero: No quote record means unknown, not 0, not an independent market line, and not a pass.

line_comparison.line_difference: model fair line − market line, in points; published separately for opening and closing
line_comparison.moneyline_comparison: model fair win probability − raw probability implied by American odds; includes vig and is not called edge
line_comparison.not_a_market_quote: A model fair line or fair price is never copied into opening/closing market fields.

leaderboard.ranking_rule: Signal status cannot be improved by a staking outcome; staking status cannot qualify a weak signal. No cross-plane composite score.
leaderboard.current_state: No live strategy, no authorized market quote, no stake, no ROI, no CLV, no reward.

demotion_gate.performance_rule: After at least 100 settled bets in the locked evaluation cohort, demote when the pre-registered one-sided 95% lower confidence bound for net ROI is at or below 0. The bound must account for the registered sampling/dependence design and the full tested strategy family.
demotion_gate.reentry: Demoted strategy returns to paper. It cannot auto-promote; it must repeat the release gates on a newly frozen prospective record.
demotion_gate.threshold_note: The 100-bet minimum matches the existing NFL results sample gate RG04. It is a disclosed project policy choice, not an NFL-published rule or a claim that 100 bets are sufficient for every market.

source_policy.observed_game_results: Existing NFL.com by-week schedule captures, reconciliation checked against standings by the results extractor.
source_policy.market_prices: No licensed quote provider or quote record is currently registered in this repository.
source_policy.rights: Do not systematically retrieve, redistribute, or publish a price feed until the specific source and use rights are documented.
